name: PRCLS - Yeah, another bookmarking app.
description: Save bookmarks from any browser with this privacy-focused tool. No ads, no tracking, just fast and simple bookmark management.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co https://*.prcls.ai https://prcls.ai; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com
